answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Election poll worker record changes that arithmetic: shifts worked at a polling station, on the record, so the haven for each fake is paid in the real world. Honest agents already carry what Election poll worker record asks for, so they pass without noticing; the saffron is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. Do the arithmetic for a hundred clones: a hundred proofs, each with its own paperwork, hardware, or history, and the delta is a budget no epoch payout can repay.
